title: Psalms
author: david
attributionNote: Many psalms carry headings associating them with David, but the Psalter is a composite collection with multiple authors and editors. The Davidic attribution is traditional.
description: The Psalter is the prayer book of the Hebrew Bible: 150 poems of praise, lament, petition and thanksgiving. This edition contains the complete Psalter, all 150 psalms.
historicalContext: The psalms were composed and collected over several centuries, with the final collection taking shape in the Second Temple period. They became central to Jewish liturgy and to Christian monastic and devotional practice.
featuredNote: The shepherd psalm and the language of trust
